data.content_ref: inline:Relation Kind: Compatibility. The defense of preference as 'conjectural risk management' (SRC_004) is compatible with the criticism that it smuggles induction (SRC_001) only if 'risk' is defined probabilistically. REFUTED IF: SRC_004 explicitly defines 'risk' in purely non-probabilistic, logical terms (e.g., severity of tests), making any probabilistic interpretation required by SRC_001's definition of induction impossible within the same framework.
